server.name: aftermath-altdata
server.description: AfterMath Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for verified whale tape, conviction flows and Telegram-funnel scoring.

tools.name: get_market_tape
tools.description: Retrieve real-time macro tape overview: whale cash reserves ($8.98M dry powder), intraday net P&L, equity/ETF allocation split, and top capital inflow & retail breadth leaders from AfterHour terminal.

tools.name: get_top_equities
tools.description: Filter and rank 500 verified stocks with customizable thresholds for whale capital, owner count, conviction intensity ($/holder), price movement, and asset type segregation.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default: 20, max: 100)

min_whale_capital.description: Minimum verified capital held by tracked whales in USD (e.g. 1000000 for $1M+)

min_conviction.description: Minimum verified position size per holder in USD (e.g. 50000 for $50k+/sub)

min_owners.description: Minimum number of verified holders on the app

tools.name: get_etf_flows
tools.description: Inspect 64 ETFs & index funds ranked by whale backing, expense ratios, asset classes (equity, broad market, thematic, crypto, fixed income), and retail crowd adoption.

tools.name: get_whale_portfolio
tools.description: Look up any verified whale account by username (e.g. 'thealexperez', 'SirJackALot', 'MisterMonster') to inspect verified positions, cost basis, unrealized profit, cash balance, and shadow ratio.

username.description: AfterHour username of the whale to audit (with or without '@')

tools.name: get_ticker_intel
tools.description: Forensic intelligence on any ticker ($NVDA, $ASTS, $AAPL, etc.) with verified holders, conviction intensity ($/sub), top whale holders breakdown, and optional 90-day daily OHLCV bars.

include_bars.description: Set to true to include the 90-day daily OHLCV candlestick price bars series

tools.name: get_conviction_screener
tools.description: Scan for asymmetric high conviction where average equity per holder exceeds a given threshold (e.g. $50,000+ or $100,000+), unmasking institutional accumulation before retail headlines.

min_intensity.description: Minimum average position size per holder in USD (default: 50000)

min_owners.description: Minimum verified owners to eliminate illiquid micro-caps (default: 15)

limit.description: Maximum number of tickers to return (default: 20)

tools.name: screen_whales
tools.description: Filter and rank 424 broker-verified whales and millionaires by net worth, cash reserves, unrealized profit, daily return, follower counts, and shadow ratio.

min_net_worth.description: Minimum verified portfolio value in USD (e.g. 1000000 for $1M+)

min_cash.description: Minimum uninvested cash balance in USD (dry powder)

min_profit.description: Minimum total unrealized profit in USD

min_followers.description: Minimum social followers on the platform

max_followers.description: Maximum social followers (useful for filtering stealth whales)

limit.description: Maximum number of whales to return (default: 20, max: 100)

tools.name: get_shadow_whales
tools.description: Scan for Clout Inversions and stealth accounts: verified traders holding high capital ($500k+ to $15M+) with negligible retail followings (<500 followers).

min_shadow_ratio.description: Minimum verified capital divided by followers (default: 2000)

limit.description: Maximum number of shadow whales to return (default: 20)

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Retrieve daily OHLCV candlestick price bars and returns for core market benchmarks and equities (NVDA, TSLA, SPY, AAPL, QQQ, MSTR, ASTS, etc.).

limit.description: Number of daily bars to return (default: 60, max: 120)

tools.name: get_social_feed
tools.description: Retrieve real-time community posts, commentary, sentiment, and broker-verified trade snapshots from AfterHour traders.

ticker.description: Filter posts mentioning a specific ticker (e.g. 'NVDA' or 'ASTS')

username.description: Filter posts authored by a specific trader handle

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return (default: 20, max: 50)

tools.name: get_funnel_accounts
tools.description: Look up AfterHour accounts flagged for funneling traders into Telegram channels, with evidence tier (reported/corroborated/verified), shared invite-link clusters, and posting stats. Check a username or t.me link before you join. Flagged for investigation, not a finding of fraud. Curated by https://telegramscammers.com (database: /database, submit intel: /submit).

telegram_link.description: t.me link or handle to look up (e.g. 't.me/gammasphere47')

tools.name: get_funnel_callouts
tools.description: Parsed trade callouts (ticker, side, strike, expiry, entry, action, quoted result) from public Telegram channels linked to flagged AfterHour accounts, with an independent scored 'outcome' where available. Quoted results are the channel's own claims, and the sample is small. Flagged for investigation, not a finding of fraud. Curated by https://telegramscammers.com.

channel.description: Channel handle or t.me link (substring match)

tools.name: get_funnel_tickers
tools.description: Tickers most called out by flagged AfterHour accounts and the Telegram channels they link to, ranked, with account, channel and post counts. Flagged for investigation, not a finding of fraud. Curated by https://telegramscammers.com.

tools.name: get_funnel_scorecard
tools.description: Public scoring results for trade callouts posted by Telegram channels linked to flagged AfterHour accounts. Section 'paths' (the main view): what each called-out option contract did after the post, from its own 5-minute trade bars (calls posted in the session get the next 30 minutes, daily callouts the whole next session; fill = open of the first bar at or after the post): share that ended above the fill, median peak and drawdown, +50%/-50% TP-first versus SL-first, fill-delay sensitivity, unfillable-quote share, per channel, ticker and hour. Section 'options': the same callouts held to expiry (secondary view). Section 'fx': forex/gold/index signals (TP1 first versus SL first, mean R). Every rate carries its sample size and a Wilson 95% range; assumptions and limitations are included (trade prints, no spread or slippage). Analysis of public posts, not advice. Flagged for investigation, not a finding of fraud. Credit https://telegramscammers.com. Method: https://ah.mphinance.com/scorecard

section.description: Which part to return: paths (price paths after the call), options (held to expiry), fx, or all (default all)

channel.description: Channel handle or t.me link (substring match); filters the per-channel tables

tools.name: get_market_session
tools.description: LIVE (60s cache). Use for 'is the market open / what session is it / when does it close'. Returns current phase (pre, regular, after, overnight, closed), early-close flag, next transition and seconds until it, computed server-side in UTC.

tools.name: get_live_quotes
tools.description: LIVE (30s cache). Use for current price. Up to 25 symbols: last price, session change, pre-market and after-hours change, OHLC, volume. Percent fields are percent units (1.1 = 1.1%). Do NOT use for whale or conviction data (use get_ticker_intel).

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: LIVE (2 min cache). Use for 'what is trending / most watched / top gainers / top losers' across the whole platform (~33k securities, crowd-ranked). Do NOT use for whale-capital ranking of the verified 500 (use get_top_equities). GAINERS only supports DAY. Percent fields are percent units.

tools.name: get_ticker_live
tools.description: LIVE (2 min cache). Any ticker on the platform: price, owner count, total value held, market cap, chatroom activity, sample owners. Use when get_ticker_intel says the ticker is not in the verified 500. No whale breakdown or OHLCV.

tools.name: get_profile_live
tools.description: LIVE (5 min cache). Public profile for any AfterHour handle, including non-whales: bio, followers, join date, whether a brokerage is linked, privacy mode. No portfolio data (use get_whale_portfolio for the 395 verified).

tools.name: get_post_permalink
tools.description: LIVE (10 min cache). Use when you already have a post link or hash: returns the body, author, attached position snapshots and the first comments. Do NOT use to browse (use get_social_feed).

hash.description: Post hash (e.g. 'bx5Y') or full afterhour.com share URL

tools.name: get_security_chart
tools.description: LIVE (5 min cache). OHLCV bars for any platform ticker at minute, hour, day, week or month resolution, up to 365 days back, last 500 bars. Superset of get_price_history, which is limited to 18 tickers of daily bars.

tools.name: get_app_status
tools.description: LIVE (5 min cache). AfterHour app remote config: feature flags and forced/recommended-update gate for the tracked Android build. Use to detect that the app shipped a change.

tools.name: compare_tickers
tools.description: SNAPSHOT (verified 500, rebuilt on deploy). Side-by-side table for 2 to 5 tickers: price, 24h and 30d move, whale capital and holders, verified owners, conviction per holder. For tickers outside the 500 use get_ticker_live.

tools.name: get_retail_sentiment
tools.description: SNAPSHOT (refreshed every 5 min). Retail stance on one ticker from public AfterHour posts: bull/bear votes, net score (-1..1), distinct voting authors, confidence tier, topic mix, top posts and quality flags. Direction comes only from explicit CALL/PUT plus an open verb, so most posts are neutral. Always read n_voting_authors and flags.

tools.name: get_retail_options_bias
tools.description: SNAPSHOT. Calls versus puts opened in public AfterHour posts: for one ticker, or the most active tickers when none given. The highest-precision sentiment signal because contract side is explicit. Sample is small.

tools.name: get_retail_buzz
tools.description: SNAPSHOT. Which tickers retail is suddenly posting about: mentions versus trailing baseline (z-score once 3+ days of archive exist, else ranked by mentions). Use for 'what is the crowd talking about'. Not a direction signal.

tools.name: get_retail_vs_whale
tools.description: SNAPSHOT. Tickers where retail stance and verified whale capital pull apart (retail bullish where little whale money sits, or bearish where a lot does). A prompt to investigate, not a signal: whale capital is size, not direction. Needs at least min_voting_authors voters.

tools.name: get_sentiment_flags
tools.description: SNAPSHOT. Quality flags for a ticker's retail sentiment: copy-paste duplicate posts, low-follower author share, authors with a Telegram link in bio, authors on the funnel list. Call before trusting get_retail_sentiment. Flagged for investigation, not a finding of fraud.

tools.name: get_ticker_posts
tools.description: SNAPSHOT of the most recent ~400 archived public posts, parsed (stance, action, tickers). Filter by ticker or username. Use to read the posts behind a sentiment score. For one post by link use get_post_permalink.

tools.name: get_sentiment_trend
tools.description: SNAPSHOT. Daily post count and net retail score for a ticker over up to 14 days of archive. Depth is limited by how long the archive has been running.

tools.name: get_live_portfolio
tools.description: LIVE (60s cache). Current positions of a PUBLIC AfterHour portfolio marked to live prices: value, share of portfolio, P&L today, options with strike, expiry and contracts. Includes last_synced_at: quantities are only as fresh as the broker sync, often months old. Use get_whale_portfolio for the cached census view.

tools.name: get_position_changes
tools.description: SNAPSHOT (polled every few minutes for top whales, twice a day for the rest). Reported quantity changes in public whale portfolios: OPEN, ADD, TRIM, CLOSE, EXPIRED, FLIP, with notional and percent of portfolio. Filter by user, ticker, action or size. Changes are rare because broker syncs are infrequent. Reported changes, not trades.

tools.name: get_ticker_whale_flow
tools.description: SNAPSHOT. Net reported whale position change in one ticker over recent days: net notional, adds/opens versus trims/closes, which whales. Options roll up to the underlying.

tools.name: get_whale_sync_health
tools.description: SNAPSHOT. How trustworthy the whale position data is right now: whales tracked, polled in the last hour, newest and oldest broker sync, count synced within 30 days. Check before reading get_position_changes.
